scope.purpose: Freeze the proposed experiment protocol for independent review; no model evaluation is authorized.
prohibited: changes to Nexus, Relay, Forge, PCT, or Playbook
scope.dev_data: All Phase 0 cases and prompts remain public dev/protocol-validation data only.

research_question.primary_research_question: On a newly generated, independently sealed test set, does a frozen local-first semantic routing configuration improve task outcome success over the deterministic Rules baseline while preserving policy invariants and staying within an independently approved resource and cost budget? If no candidate meets feasibility or evidentiary requirements, report insufficient evidence or candidate not feasible rather than infer an advantage.

controlled_routing_comparison.purpose: Compare decision behavior under the same router-visible information and availability conditions.
allowed_router_input: frozen scenario/availability state only where every included method consumes the same value
comparison_objects: only candidate adapters that accept an identical canonical metadata payload without extra prompt-derived fields
controlled_routing_comparison.eligibility: No candidate adapter is presumed eligible. If the shared serialized input contract cannot be demonstrated, it is excluded from this track.
allowed_conclusions: router decision distribution and correctness against verified routing gold
router-only latency under the pinned environment
prohibited_conclusions: task answer quality or task outcome success from decision labels
equal-information algorithm comparison where actual inputs differ

end_to_end_system_comparison.purpose: Compare whole frozen router-adapter-executor configurations on the same task fixtures and outcome rubric.
end_to_end_system_comparison.allowed_input: Each configured router and adapter may consume only its documented, pinned supported inputs; task text can be provided to components that actually support it. Rules receives metadata only; its executor receives the task prompt after routing.
comparison_objects: each independently reviewed router + adapter + executor configuration that passes license, safety, and feasibility gates
end_to_end_system_comparison.required_reporting: List actual router and executor inputs, mappings, adapter identity, and model pair for every configuration.
allowed_conclusions: measured local resource use and applicable token/API cost
prohibited_conclusions: router-only causal advantage when executor/configuration/input differences remain
universal model quality or production value beyond the tested configurations

tracks.separation: Tracks are analyzed and reported separately; no metric is transferred between tracks.

generation_method.source_frame: PRE_REGISTRATION_REQUIRED: data owner must identify target task population, strata, inclusion/exclusion criteria, and source/authoring method before case production.
procedure: Freeze population, task-family/language/risk strata, sampling or authoring quotas, rubrics, and generator version before generating cases.
A data custodian who does not implement or tune candidate routers creates or samples new cases after adapters and configurations are frozen.
Do not copy, paraphrase, relabel, or select from Phase 0 fixtures; do not use model outputs to author or filter cases.
Use only authorized, de-identified or purpose-authored content; record provenance and rights for each case.

split_and_access.dev: Existing 12 public Phase 0 cases/prompts; available for protocol validation and adapter development only.
split_and_access.independent_test: New cases only, disjoint IDs and content; held by an independent custodian in a private access-controlled location, never committed to this public repository before evaluation.
split_and_access.train: None authorized; no training, fine-tuning, threshold tuning, or calibration in this experiment.
split_and_access.separation: Router implementers and configuration selectors do not receive held-out prompts, labels, or per-case digests before final configuration lock. The custodian logs access. Independent adjudicators do not see router identity/output when labeling gold.

leakage_prevention: Keep held-out contents and unsalted content hashes outside the public repository and away from adapter/configuration authors until the run is locked.
Check exact and normalized-text overlap against Phase 0 and any declared source benchmark; use semantic/manual review for likely paraphrase overlap.
Record known source benchmark contamination and model-pretraining uncertainty; do not claim pretraining leakage is fully detectable.
No held-out inspection, prompt editing, example selection, or threshold adjustment after any candidate output is seen.

Any post-unseal change to case, rubric, adapter, prompt template, threshold, or model configuration invalidates that test version for confirmatory use and requires a newly generated version plus review.

identity_and_seal.case_id: Random opaque UUID assigned once by custodian; stable across tracks, not content-derived, never reused across splits.
identity_and_seal.prompt_digest: SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 task_input bytes as stored in the sealed record; normalization/line-ending policy is fixed before generation and recorded.
identity_and_seal.input_digest: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON for the exact router payload (sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false); keep separate digests for each track/configuration payload. Do not pass the task prompt to Controlled routers.
identity_and_seal.sealed_manifest: Store dataset version, generation procedure/version, split, case IDs, file-level and per-case digest, rubric version, access-control record, and creation timestamp in a signed/append-only private manifest. Publish only a commitment that does not expose recoverable prompt hashes before unseal.
identity_and_seal.unseal: Custodian releases cases to the frozen runner only after Sol review and all hard gates are satisfied; record exact sealed-manifest digest and unseal event in the run receipt.

gold_and_blinding.routing_gold: At least two independent adjudicators review the frozen routing policy and permitted metadata without router outputs or execution outcomes. They label independently; a third adjudicator resolves disagreement. Store rubric/version, individual labels, adjudicated label, rationale, and disagreement.
gold_and_blinding.task_outcome_gold: For executable cases, use a frozen itemized rubric and fixed executor. Reviewers see anonymized outputs, not router/system identity, route decision, or attempt history where that history is not required to score the rubric. Two reviewers score independently; a third resolves disagreement.
gold_and_blinding.unknown: If policy or output evidence is insufficient or adjudicators cannot resolve a label, preserve UNKNOWN with reason. Never force a label or silently remove the case. Report unknown/unscorable counts and rates.

unknown_handling.analysis: Intention-to-treat by assigned case. Technical failure, abstention, escalation, or fallback remains an observed result and is not dropped.
unknown_handling.decision_accuracy: UNKNOWN gold is excluded from the scorable accuracy numerator and denominator, with eligible, scored, and UNKNOWN counts/rates reported separately.
unknown_handling.task_success: A valid judged output that fails any required rubric item is failure. Missing/corrupt output is task failure if attributable to the system; otherwise outcome is UNKNOWN with reason and retained in the flow accounting.
unknown_handling.policy_unknown: Unknown risk or sensitivity must follow the frozen fail-closed policy; a missing policy input is reported and is not recoded as safe.

sample_size_and_statistics.design: Paired case-level comparison on the same sealed cases; report raw counts and paired differences. Stratify descriptive results by predeclared task/language/risk strata.
sample_size_and_statistics.sample_size_rationale: A defensible n requires a target effect or precision objective, expected paired discordance/variance, outcome prevalence, alpha, power, multiplicity plan, and clustering/strata assumptions. No suitable independent pilot variance or target effect is currently available; the 12 exposed dev cases cannot justify n.
sample_size_and_statistics.candidate_primary_test: For binary paired case outcomes, exact McNemar is a candidate test; Sol must accept the test and preregister alpha/power or precision target. Calculate n from a justified minimally meaningful paired difference and discordant-pair rate, with sensitivity analysis over plausible discordance rates. These inputs are currently unavailable.
sample_size_and_statistics.interpretation: No statistical pass/fail, superiority, or non-inferiority claim until Sol independently accepts the target parameters and they are frozen before unsealing.

metrics.controlled_primary: Decision correctness against adjudicated verified routing gold, only for cases with non-UNKNOWN gold and only if candidate passes identical-input eligibility.
metrics.end_to_end_primary: Blinded task outcome success rate over executable independent-test cases under intention-to-treat accounting.

secondary.name: decision_correctness
secondary.unit: correct decisions / scorable decisions; percentage and raw counts
secondary.aggregation: per system and predeclared strata; paired case difference
secondary.unknown: UNKNOWN gold excluded from scorable denominator and reported separately

secondary.name: task_outcome_success
secondary.unit: rubric-passing tasks / executable assigned tasks; percentage and raw counts
secondary.aggregation: per system and predeclared strata; paired case difference
secondary.unknown: Missing/corrupt system output is failure if attributable; otherwise UNKNOWN and shown in flow counts

secondary.name: abstain_escalation_correctness
secondary.unit: correct abstain/escalate decisions / cases where verified policy gold requires or permits that action
secondary.aggregation: counts, rate, and paired case difference

secondary.name: over_escalation
secondary.unit: unnecessary escalation/abstention decisions / cases whose verified gold permits an automated available route
secondary.aggregation: count and rate; paired case difference
secondary.unknown: UNKNOWN gold excluded from denominator and reported

secondary.name: router_latency
secondary.aggregation: raw per-call values and per-case median; cold start/load/first-call reported separately
secondary.unknown: missing timing is UNKNOWN; do not impute

secondary.name: end_to_end_latency
secondary.unit: milliseconds per assigned task, with router/executor components where measurable
secondary.aggregation: raw values and per-case median; queue/human wait shown separately
secondary.unknown: not applicable when no execution occurs; missing measurement is UNKNOWN

secondary.name: local_resource_usage
secondary.unit: peak resident RAM MiB, peak VRAM MiB, CPU-seconds, and process load time
secondary.aggregation: per run/configuration with measurement tool and sampling interval; report maxima and raw samples
secondary.unknown: unmeasured resource is UNKNOWN; no inference from parameter count

secondary.name: api_token_cost
secondary.unit: input/output tokens and currency per case and total, when an authorized API is used
secondary.aggregation: provider-reported usage and dated price source; router calls included
secondary.unknown: not applicable for fully local configurations; missing provider usage/cost is UNKNOWN, not zero

secondary.name: fallback_behavior
secondary.unit: fallback events / assigned decisions, with failure class and attempt count
secondary.aggregation: counts and rates by predefined failure class; preserve every attempt in order
secondary.unknown: unclassifiable cause is UNKNOWN and retained

secondary.name: unknown_rate
secondary.unit: UNKNOWN or unscorable labels / assigned cases, separately by source (gold, output, runtime, cost, identity)
secondary.aggregation: counts and rates by system, metric, and predeclared stratum
secondary.unknown: UNKNOWN is counted as the metric value; never silently dropped

policy_invariants: confidential input is never sent to a cloud target
unavailable target is never reported as executable
unknown/high-risk policy inputs fail closed or escalate per frozen policy
metrics.invariant_failure: Any observed violation halts the affected run immediately and is reported; it cannot be averaged against quality gains.

environment.cpu: Intel Core i7-10750H, 6 cores / 12 threads reported by lscpu
environment.ram: 16,284,284 kB total reported by /proc/meminfo (~15.5 GiB); availability varies by process/session
environment.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060, 6,144 MiB; nvidia-smi driver 596.36
environment.execution_environment_identity: Host identity beyond the reported WSL kernel/CPU/GPU is not uniquely attested. Capture OS build, WSL distribution/version, driver, CPU affinity, memory limit, environment/container digest, and UTC timestamp in the actual run receipt.
environment.dependency_environment_plan: Use an isolated locked Python environment and record lockfile digest, Python build, OS packages, CUDA/runtime libraries, environment variables relevant to device/thread behavior, and installation provenance. Exact dependency lock is PRE_REGISTRATION_REQUIRED before Stage B.
environment.runner_identity: No benchmark runner exists. Runner commit and version are PRE_REGISTRATION_REQUIRED before Stage B; bind to exact Git commit and dirty-tree state in receipts.
environment.hardware_capture_method: Observed using uname, python --version/platform, lscpu, /proc/meminfo, and nvidia-smi. Hardware virtualization/resource caps can differ from physical host; verify effective limits at execution time.

budget_and_stops.future_max_model_downloads: PRE_REGISTRATION_REQUIRED; Sol must approve exact number of checkpoint artifacts and per-artifact/aggregate byte caps before any download.
budget_and_stops.future_max_disk_use: PRE_REGISTRATION_REQUIRED; human confirmation required after candidate artifact sizes and available storage are known.
budget_and_stops.future_max_wall_clock: PRE_REGISTRATION_REQUIRED; human confirmation required before evaluation.
budget_and_stops.future_max_benchmark_reruns: PRE_REGISTRATION_REQUIRED; human confirmation required; no benchmark run is authorized in Stage A.
failure_stops: Any confidential-to-cloud transfer, unavailable-target selection, or other frozen safety invariant violation: stop affected run immediately.
Any paid API call or non-zero charge: stop immediately; this phase budget is zero.
Missing/mismatched case, prompt, input, candidate, environment, or receipt identity: stop and preserve the run as invalid/incomplete.
Missing license grant or unsupported language/input capability: exclude the candidate; do not silently substitute another checkpoint.
Any held-out exposure before configuration lock, or any post-unseal tuning: invalidate that held-out version and stop confirmatory claims.
Exceeding any later Sol-approved download, disk, wall-clock, call, or rerun cap: stop immediately.
budget_and_stops.environment_incompatibility_stop: If a pinned candidate cannot install/load/run in the approved environment or requires unregistered network services, record candidate not feasible and stop that candidate; do not change hardware, checkpoint, dependencies, or track silently. A changed environment requires a new reviewed preregistration version.
budget_and_stops.same_root_repair_stop: At most one bounded repair attempt for an identified root cause. If the same root cause recurs after that repair, stop implementation/evaluation for that candidate and return for review; a new issue name or test does not reset this local cap.
budget_and_stops.rerun_semantics: Per-case repeated inference/timing replicates are distinct from full benchmark reruns; exact replicate counts and any rerun cap must be approved before Stage B.

playbook_preflight.material_design_change: No experiment design/verification rule was changed by an adopted Current rule. The accepted control baseline changed only authority framing: drafts/candidates remain non-normative and passing deterministic checks is not described as proof of study validity or model performance.

review_gates.review_target: This exact Stage A commit and its manifest/schema/tests.
must_resolve_before_stage_b: sample size, statistical test, alpha/power or precision target, multiplicity plan
non-inferiority margin and acceptance threshold or explicit decision to use no confirmatory pass threshold
independent-test sampling frame, strata, sample count, custodian and access controls
candidate inclusion, exact adapter/configuration/executor and complete checkpoint/license review
dependency lock, runner identity, environment limits and hardware feasibility
download count/byte cap, disk cap, wall-clock cap and benchmark rerun cap
review_gates.stage_b_eligibility: false until independent Sol review accepts the exact subject and each PRE_REGISTRATION_REQUIRED item is resolved or explicitly waived in a versioned review decision.
